audience.text: Python developers building desktop or server applications that require deterministic reading, writing, and conversion of Outlook .msg files and CFB containers without external dependencies or Microsoft Outlook.

capabilities.text: Read and write Outlook .msg files using MapiMessage, MsgReader, MsgWriter, and MsgDocument APIs.
capabilities.title: Read and write Outlook .msg files

capabilities.text: Convert between Outlook .msg and standard .eml formats using MapiMessage.to_email_message() and from_email_message() with Python's email.message.EmailMessage.
capabilities.title: Convert between .msg and .eml

capabilities.text: Inspect and construct Compound File Binary (CFB) containers using CFBReader, CFBWriter, CFBStorage, and CFBStream APIs.
capabilities.title: Inspect and build CFB containers

capabilities.text: Set and retrieve MAPI properties, recipients, and attachments (including embedded messages) on MapiMessage objects.
capabilities.title: Manage message properties and attachments

capabilities.text: The library requires no third-party packages, compiled extensions, or native libraries beyond Python 3.10+.
capabilities.title: No external dependencies

limitations.text: The library does not connect to mail servers and lacks IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 support.
TNEF (Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format, winmail.dat) is not parsed or generated.
There is no dedicated calendar or appointment API; calendar-specific MAPI properties must be accessed generically.
Direct .eml file parsing is not implemented; EML support requires Python's email.parser and EmailMessage.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic parsing and generation of Outlook .msg files and CFB containers using pure Python, eliminating reliance on COM interop, compiled extensions, or Microsoft Outlook.
Provides two-way conversion between Outlook .msg and standard .eml formats via Python's email.message.EmailMessage, supporting interoperability with other email tools.
Supports low-level CFB and MSG structure inspection and construction through dedicated readers, writers, and document models.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for processing Outlook .msg and Compound File Binary (CFB) files, with two-way conversion to/from Python's standard EmailMessage for .eml interoperability.

workflows.name: Read MSG subject
workflows.text: Load an .msg file using MapiMessage.from_file() and access its subject property.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG
workflows.text: Create a new MapiMessage, set sender, recipients, attachments, and properties, then save it as .msg or convert to .eml.

workflows.name: Convert MSG to EML
workflows.text: Load an .msg file, convert it to EmailMessage via to_email_message(), and write to .eml using as_bytes().

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Parse an .eml file using Python's BytesParser, then construct a MapiMessage from the EmailMessage and save as .msg.

workflows.name: Inspect CFB structure
workflows.text: Build or read a CFB container using CFBReader/CFBWriter and traverse storages and streams.
